decisions.what: Added DATABASE_URL and commented-out DIRECT_URL to apps/backend/.env.example
decisions.why: Spec required a documented PostgreSQL connection string plus optional pooling URL for services like Supabase; keeping DIRECT_URL commented avoids overriding the default direct connection.

decisions.what: Added @prisma/client and prisma dependencies plus prisma:* scripts and prisma.seed config to apps/backend/package.json
decisions.why: Enables running prisma generate/migrate/studio and the tsx-based seed script exactly as described in the task.

decisions.what: Modeled Prisma enums (UserRole, BookingStatus, PaymentStatus, NotificationType, NotificationChannel, NotificationStatus) instead of stringly-typed columns
decisions.why: Prisma requires named enum types; splitting per model keeps the schema self-documenting and matches the enum values listed in the spec.

decisions.what: Seed script clears data in dependency order and uses bcrypt to hash the demo passwords
decisions.why: FK constraints require dependents (payments/bookings/notifications/audit logs) to be removed before users/services; bcrypt was explicitly requested in the spec.

decisions.what: Reused apps/backend/src/config/environment.ts to detect production instead of reading NODE_ENV directly in the Prisma singleton
decisions.why: Matches the existing config abstraction and avoids duplicating environment parsing logic.

decisions.what: Prisma integration test asserts that user deletion is rejected while related bookings exist (rather than cascading)
decisions.why: The schema does not declare onDelete: Cascade for the User <- Booking relation, so the expected behavior is FK rejection; documenting that keeps the test aligned with the schema.

decisions.what: Docker Compose uses postgres:15-alpine with a named postgres_data volume and pg_isready healthcheck
decisions.why: Matches the task requirements verbatim while providing a persistent local database that mirrors production.
